name: Cage of Vipers Trap (CR 5)
body:
Cage of Vipers Trap

CR 5

XP 1,600

Type mechanical; Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 20

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset none

Effect Atk +10 ranged (1d6) plus 1d4+1 vipers attack

A small cage filled with vipers is hidden high in the treetops. The cage is suddenly opened and the serpents released when a tripwire is sprung on the ground below. First, the metal cage falls on the head of anyone beneath the tree, then the snakes strike.
